# obs.earnings_date r1

obs.earnings_date r1: one answer about the next earnings date of one issuer on one day; append only, an error is a row and a later success is a new attempt.

| column | type | nullable | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| observed_on | string (date) | no | Session day (XNYS) the row answers for. |
| issuer | string | no | The issuer text of the watch list: cik:<10 digits>, or edinet:<code>. |
| attempt | integer | no | Attempt number of the day, from 1; a later attempt never replaces an earlier row. |
| symbol | string | no | Symbol as the vendor or the watch list gave it. |
| market | enum(US, JP) | no | Market of the issuer. |
| status | enum(listed, absent, unsupported, error) | no | listed: the source gave a date; absent: the source has no date for the issuer; unsupported: no source covers the issuer; error: the source failed. Only listed carries a report_date. |
| report_date | string (date) | yes | Earliest listed date on or after observed_on; null unless status is listed. The key is always present. |
| fiscal_period_end | string (date) | yes | End of the fiscal period the report covers; null when the source does not say. |
| time_of_day | string | no | Time text of the source, for example pre-market or post-market; empty when none. |
| estimate | string | yes | Estimate of the source as decimal text, currency not stored; null when none. |
| error_code | string | no | Error code when status is error, for example rate_limited; empty otherwise. |
| source | enum(alphavantage, jquants, owner, none) | no | Where the row came from; owner is a report_date_override (the only row of that issuer that day, attempt 1); none is a status unsupported row, since no source produced it. Never null. |
| received_at | string (date-time) | no | Instant the row was produced, UTC. |
